facts.statement: Squatirhina is classified as a member of the class Chondrichthyes and the order Rajiformes, with its family placement listed as incertae sedis.
facts.quote:
regnum: Animalia
phylum: Chordata
classis: Chondrichthyes
ordo: Rajiformes
familia: incertae sedis

facts.statement: The genus Squatirhina was described by Casier in 1947.
Squatirhina lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Squatirhina is a genus of rajiforms that lived in Late Cretaceous

facts.statement: The time range for Squatirhina spans from the Barremian to the Maastrichtian, between 125.77 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Maastrichtian (125.77 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossils of Squatirhina have been found in the Aguja and Pen Formations of Big Bend National Park in Texas, USA.
facts.quote: whose fossils have been found in the Aguja and Pen Formations of Big Bend National Park, Texas, USA.

facts.statement: There are 69 recorded fossil occurrences of Squatirhina in the Paleobiology Database.
